children: announced that its board of directors has
authorizing the buyback of up to $100M of its outstanding common stock.
The program will run through September 17, 2027.
The timing and volume of any buybacks will remain at management's discretion, governed by general market conditions, prevailing stock prices, and broader business considerations.
CAVA plans to finance the repurchases using existing cash reserves, cash equivalents, and ongoing cash flows from operations.
The company noted that the program does not obligate it to buy back a set number of shares and can be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time.
